md: - **Vemulavada Chalukyas** (Karimnagar, Rashtrakuta feudatories): strong **Jain** patrons – Pampa, **Somadeva Suri**; Jinavallabha's **Kurkyala** inscription has early **Telugu** verses.
- **Ghatika:** a **Brahminical (Vedic) college** of Brahmin scholars, usually **attached to temples**, Sanskrit medium; **agrahara** = land grant to Brahmins.
- **Jats (Bharatpur):** **Suraj Mal** (1755–63), the "**Plato of the Jat tribe**", built **Lohagarh** fort; earlier leaders Gokula, Raja Ram, **Churaman**.
- **Fort design:** Vijayanagara walls enclosed **agricultural tracts** (fields, gardens) so the city could withstand **sieges** (Domingo Paes).
- **Significance:** these campaigns were the **first step** of Sultanate power into the south; **annexation** came only under **Muhammad bin Tughlaq**.
- **Significance:** Khanwa, more than Panipat, **firmly established** Mughal power in India.
